profile.headline: Experienced Software II Engineer at Microsoft | Windows, AI, Platform Engineering
profile.summary:
Software engineer and technical leader specializing in AI-powered automation, cloud services, and developer productivity. I design and operate large-scale engineering systems that automate complex servicing workflows, improve reliability and security, and reduce manual effort across organizations.
My work spans C#, .NET, Azure, distributed systems, APIs, observability, and AI agents. I enjoy turning specialized engineering knowledge into reusable platforms and tools, leading cross-team architecture, and mentoring engineers toward greater technical ownership. I’m especially motivated by difficult problems at the intersection of automation, operational excellence, and responsible AI adoption.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Architect and lead an AI-powered engineering automation platform that handles complex servicing, code integration, validation, and pull-request workflows across large-scale software repositories.  
• Design cloud-native services using C#, .NET, Azure Functions, Durable Task Framework, Azure Storage, Application Insights, OpenTelemetry, and secure REST APIs.  
• Build AI agents, reusable skills, and developer tools that convert specialized engineering knowledge into accessible, repeatable workflows for other engineers.  
• Delivered measurable reliability and efficiency improvements, including a 17× increase in monthly processing throughput, a 98%+ reduction in repeated external API calls, and automation supporting thousands of engineering changes.  
• Lead cross-team architecture and operational initiatives spanning security, observability, incident response, policy compliance, and responsible AI adoption.  
• Mentor engineers and vendor contributors through design reviews, production debugging, testing strategy, and ownership of independently delivered features.  
• Partner with engineering, security, servicing, and infrastructure teams to turn ambiguous requirements and production issues into scalable, maintainable solutions.

positions.title: Software Design Engineer (Microsoft Vendor)
positions.description:
Worked closely with CSD (Cosine Servicing and Delivery) to create an Application that Engineers and their leads could use to monitor monthly testing results for security and non-security bug fixes for a range of more than 12 products. Included a heads up display, automatic refresh, and a customizable query for specific test results.

Implemented knowledge of C#, SQL, XAML Views Formatting, and LINQ to create a Windows Forms Application.

positions.title: Code Coach
positions.description:
Developed strategies for sustainable retention of coding knowledge.
Fostered side-by-side coding to promote collaborative learning.
Established methods for ensuring understanding of core algorithmic and code knowledge.

https://www.thecoderschool.com/bellevue

positions.title: Mapping Team Lead Autonomous (via Ryzen Solutions)
positions.description:
Improve team efficiency above 150% by implementing a personalized strategy.
Effectively lead a team of 10+ through individual training, feedback, and quality control of datasets.
Collaborated closely with the team to design, develop, and manage flexible solutions.

positions.title: Lead GIS Analyst Intern
positions.description:
Lead Intern GIS data collector for the State of Washington.
Contacted government, municipal, and private entities to collect necessary maps.
Incorporate Geographic Information Systems (GIS) concepts and design methods.
Created, developed, and maintained databases, performed data creation, and utilized cartographic knowledge to cultivate political maps using Arc Map.

Displayed courtesy and strong interpersonal skills with all customer interactions.
